newsitem.title: USA: Eastern Enterprises sees lower Q1 shr.
newsitem.headline: Eastern Enterprises sees lower Q1 shr.

text.p: Eastern Enterprises said on Thursday it appears that its first quarter earnings will fall below the $1.61 a share it reported on last year's first quarter.
Eastern Enterprises was expected to report earnings per share of $1.65, according to First Call's consensus estimates made by securities analysts.
The company said many factors can cause swings in its operating results, but its Midland and Boston Gas units are experiencing a slow start in 1997.
Eastern Enterprises said billing temperatures so far this year in Boston Gas's service territory are 17 percent warmer than the year ago period.
Also, the colder temperatures led to record operating earnings at Boston Gas last year.
At its Midland unit, higher fuel costs and a current weakness in coal and grain markets will hurt first quarter results, Eastern Enterprises said.
